_comment: Issue #77: the settings + accessibility surface, canonical end-to-end. No fixture needed -- boots straight at title (starts_at_title) so the FIRST phase covers the boot path (settings.cfg loaded before title, the bus-routing fix live from process start) via Settings opened from the TITLE screen; the SECOND phase re-opens it from the in-game PAUSE menu after a real New Game, proving the SAME panel/state survives the title->world boundary and a later save/load round-trip. Covers: (1) the CONFIRMED bus-routing bug fix -- AudioServer.get_bus_send('UI') == 'SFX' (a real bus-GRAPH assertion, not by ear), SFX untouched (still sends to Master); (2) a real SFX volume slider move asserted via AudioServer.get_bus_volume_db (linear_to_db formula, headless-real since wi_audio.gd's bus setup is no longer headless-gated); (3) fullscreen toggle via its ui_settings_rendered payload; (4) a text-scale step change (100%->115%) immediately followed by a real interact-at-spawn (facing RIGHT from the classless-start default (2,3), (3,3) is open floor -- INTERACT_NOTHING) proving the TOAST panel (a copy-fit-budgeted surface) still renders cleanly post-scale; (5) reduce_motion toggled, then proven to SURVIVE a full Save->Load round-trip (which tears down and rebuilds EVERY UI layer, including this panel itself, via game_loaded's swap_to_world) by reading the live WISettings autoload directly, not the save file; (6) the Controls reference sub-page renders; (7) Replay Hints fires its confirmation + toast, re-arming the two one-shot session hints WITHOUT touching any accomplishment counter (see wi_settings.gd's replay_hints() doc comment); (8) settings.cfg exists on disk both immediately at boot (WIAudio's own unconditional first-save) and again at the very end. Every control exercised through BOTH a keyboard path (move+confirm) and a mouse path (click_title_row/click_pause_row/click_settings_row) somewhere in the run, per the issue #84 standard. Issue #87: (9) the Combat Speed row (Normal/Fast/Instant) -- a mouse click on the title-side visit steps it 0->1 (Fast), a keyboard confirm on the pause-side visit steps it 1->2 (Instant), and the FINAL persistence proof (after the same Save->Load round trip reduce_motion already survives) confirms combat_speed_step stays 2 -- proving the append-only ROWS discipline held (every pre-existing row index this script pins was shifted, never re-pointed at the wrong control) and that the new setting round-trips through WISettings' config-file idiom exactly like every sibling setting.

steps._comment: == BOOT-PATH PROOF (before any player action): the bus graph fix is live from process start, and settings.cfg already exists (WIAudio's own _load_settings->set_bus_volume chain writes it unconditionally at _ready()).
== TITLE -> Settings (MOUSE path): row 5 = 'Settings' (ROWS appended at the end, never inserted earlier).

assert_event_logged (whole-log scan), not wait_for_event: this exact all-defaults snapshot already fired as part of open() itself (BEFORE ui_settings_shown, by construction -- see settings_panel.gd's open() doc comment), so it's already behind the forward-only wait cursor by the time ui_settings_shown resolves; nothing LATER reproduces all-defaults once the very next steps start changing values.
== SFX slider (KEYBOARD path): cursor starts at 'Master volume' (index 0) on a fresh open() -- down x2 reaches 'SFX volume' (index 2).
== Fullscreen toggle: down x1 -> 'Fullscreen' (index 3), Confirm flips it.
== Text Scale step: down x1 -> 'Text Scale' (index 4), Confirm cycles 100%->115% (step 0->1).

== Combat Speed (MOUSE path, issue #87): row 10 = 'Combat Speed' (index 9, appended before 'Back' -- 'Help...' keeps its own index 8). Confirm/click forwards by one step (0 Normal -> 1 Fast), same as the Text Scale/volume rows' click semantics.
Mouse opens Help; payload pins section count + field-readout copy.

== New Game (MOUSE path): row 1 = 'New Game'. Classless-start default spawn (2,3), facing RIGHT -- lands on the open (3,3) cell.

== COPY-FIT PROOF at the scaled font: an interact into open ground -> INTERACT_NOTHING -> the TOAST panel (a budgeted surface, TOAST_FIELDS' own family) renders cleanly through message_layer.gd's LIVE theme-font wrap math -- no hang, no truncation garbage, exact text.

steps._comment: Same assert_event_logged fix as the title-side open above -- this snapshot fires as part of open() itself, before ui_settings_shown.

== Controls reference sub-page: down x1 -> 'Controls...' (index 6), Confirm opens it -- data-driven row count from WIInputHints.LABELS.kb.

(index 8), Confirm opens it -- re-pins the SAME rendered event/section string as the title-side click leg above, proving the sub-page renders identically from the in-game pause entry point too (the fresh-instance-per-swap contract every other sub-page here already carries).

== Close settings (KEYBOARD path): down x1 from 'Combat Speed' -> 'Back' (index 10, now the last row -- shifted again by 'Combat Speed' being appended before it, issue #87), Confirm closes -- the pause menu resumes right where it was (cursor untouched, no re-open).

== SAVE / LOAD round trip: pause_menu's own cursor is still on 'Settings' (index 7, the row that opened it) -- down x2 reaches 'Save' (index 1). Issue #78: Confirm here now opens the 3-slot picker instead of saving directly -- a second Confirm (default cursor 0, slot 'manual') is what actually saves and closes the whole pause menu, same end state as before.
Save closed the pause menu -- reopen (fresh cursor 0) and down x2 reaches 'Load' (index 2), which likewise opens the picker first.

Config-file idiom, NOT save data.
